MeshAgent_26846b1_mingw13_x64_meshconsol.build_flags: -O0, mirroring upstream Release /Od; -g; two build-tree patches, see notes
MeshAgent_26846b1_mingw13_x64_meshconsol.notes: NOT byte-identical to a build of unmodified upstream: the recipe applies two build-tree patches. wincrypto.cpp splits 'BYTE ByteData = ...' into a declaration and an assignment (the goto to 'error' crosses the initialisation); ILibParsers.c gives ILibInet_ntop/ILibInet_pton the parameter types ILibParsers.h declares (GCC rejects conflicting types). A generated forced-include also reduces __try/__except to a plain block (the exception filter never runs) and maps _get_timezone/_get_daylight to _timezone/_daylight. Forwarding headers fix include-name case. OpenSSL 1.1.1w and zlib 1.3.1 are shared DLLs; Duktape is one DLL per executable with an import library for the host timeout callback.
